COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 28, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:30 PM

Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner
Irma Archuleta, Vice Chair  Maria Gonzalez, Commissioner
Jennifer Allen Harper, Commissioner  Alyce LaViolette, Commissioner
Dr. Stephanie Anckle, Commissioner  Vanessa Mosqueda, Commissioner

  REVISED

  COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS VIA IN-PERSON/VIRTUAL HYBRID MEETING
  PURSUANT TO AB 2449 (GOV. CODE SECTION 54953.8.3(c)(2))

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO ALANAH.GRANT@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 939 3435 2621
  HTTPS://LONGBEACH-GOV.ZOOM.US/J/93934352621

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54141  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meeting of Monday, December 8, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54146  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the National Association
  of Commissions for Women on its purpose, priorities, and membership.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 28, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:30 PM

3.  26-54147  Recommendation to receive and file a Human Trafficking 101 Training from the
  Long Beach Human Trafficking Taskforce.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54148  Recommendation to review and discuss the Commission’s quarterly progress on
  its Strategic Priorities for the 2025-2026 Commission Year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54149  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact he Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
